Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From f76a16adc485699f95bb71fce114f97c832fe664 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Josh Poimboeuf <jpoimboe@redhat.com>
Date: Wed, 6 Mar 2019 11:07:24 -0600
Subject: [PATCH] x86/unwind/orc: Fix ORC unwind table alignment

The .orc_unwind section is a packed array of 6-byte structs.  It's
currently aligned to 6 bytes, which is causing warnings in the LLD
linker.

Six isn't a power of two, so it's not a valid alignment value.  The
actual alignment doesn't matter much because it's an array of packed
structs.  An alignment of two is sufficient.  In reality it always gets
aligned to four bytes because it comes immediately after the
4-byte-aligned .orc_unwind_ip section.

Fixes: ee9f8fce9964 ("x86/unwind: Add the ORC unwinder")
Reported-by: Nick Desaulniers <ndesaulniers@google.com>
Reported-by: Dmitry Golovin <dima@golovin.in>
Reported-by: Sedat Dilek <sedat.dilek@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Josh Poimboeuf <jpoimboe@redhat.com>
Signed-off-by: Thomas Gleixner <tglx@linutronix.de>
Tested-by: Sedat Dilek <sedat.dilek@gmail.com>
Cc: Peter Zijlstra <peterz@infradead.org>
Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Link: https://github.com/ClangBuiltLinux/linux/issues/218
Link: https://lkml.kernel.org/r/d55027ee95fe73e952dcd8be90aebd31b0095c45.1551892041.git.jpoimboe@redhat.com

diff --git a/include/asm-generic/vmlinux.lds.h b/include/asm-generic/vmlinux.lds.h
index 3d7a6a9c2370..f8f6f04c4453 100644
--- a/include/asm-generic/vmlinux.lds.h
+++ b/include/asm-generic/vmlinux.lds.h
@@ -733,7 +733,7 @@
 		KEEP(*(.orc_unwind_ip))					\
 		__stop_orc_unwind_ip = .;				\
 	}								\
-	. = ALIGN(6);							\
+	. = ALIGN(2);							\
 	.orc_unwind : AT(ADDR(.orc_unwind) - LOAD_OFFSET) {		\
 		__start_orc_unwind = .;					\
 		KEEP(*(.orc_unwind))					\
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `include/asm-generic/vmlinux.lds.h`**
   - The alignment directive for the `.orc_unwind` section was changed from `ALIGN(6)` to `ALIGN(2)`. This modification ensures that the section is aligned to 2 bytes instead of 6 bytes, addressing the issue of invalid alignment value as 6 is not a power of two.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The change in alignment from 6 to 2 bytes in the `.orc_unwind` section is directly related to the need for valid alignment values in the linker. The previous alignment caused warnings in the LLD linker, and since the section consists of packed 6-byte structs, an alignment of 2 bytes is sufficient. This modification resolves the alignment issue while maintaining the integrity of the packed structure, thus fixing the bug reported by multiple users.
